title: Migration loop reads user_version once; breaks for future migrations
description: The migrate() function in lib.rs reads PRAGMA user_version once at the start, then loops through MIGRATIONS. When migration 1 sets user_version to 1 and execution continues to migration 2, the loop compares migration 2's target version against the ORIGINAL user_version read, not the updated value. This works today (only 1 migration) but is latent. A future contributor adding migration 2+ will create a broken migration runner. Fix: re-read PRAGMA user_version after each execution, or change the loop structure to compare indices.
